# shadcn_liveview component index

One row per family. `use ShadcnLiveview` imports every function component; call them as `<.name ...>`.
Module: `ShadcnLiveview.Components.<CamelFamily>` in `lib/shadcn_liveview/components/<family>.ex` (`form` is `ShadcnLiveview.Form` in `lib/shadcn_liveview/form.ex`, `data_table` is `ShadcnLiveview.DataTable` in `lib/shadcn_liveview/data_table.ex`). Full docs: `h Module` / moduledoc.

How to read a row:
- Functions: every public function component of the family (arity 1).
- Required: `fn(attr, <:slot>)` must be passed; `context` comes from the parent's `:let` slot.
- Enums: `attr=a*/b/c` allowed values, `*` = default; `fn.attr` when not on the root function.
- State: controlled attrs kept in your assigns (`open`, `value`, `checked`, `pressed`); `default_*` = uncontrolled initial value.
- Events: `on_*="name"` LiveView event pushed by default (no default = set it to receive events); `(JS)` takes `Phoenix.LiveView.JS`; `payload` keys arrive as string keys in `handle_event/3`.
- Hook: colocated hook name (`<Module>.<Hook>`); interactive families need a stable `id`. Register hooks via `priv/static/shadcn-hooks.js`.
- Docs: upstream shadcn/ui reference for behavior and composition.

`<.icon name="...">` Lucide names: archive, arrow-down, arrow-left, arrow-right, arrow-up, arrow-up-down, arrow-up-right, at-sign, bell, bookmark, briefcase, building, calendar, chart-bar, chart-column, chart-line, chart-pie, check, chevron-down, chevron-left, chevron-right, chevron-up, chevrons-left, chevrons-right, chevrons-up-down, circle, circle-alert, circle-check, circle-dot, circle-plus, circle-question-mark, circle-user, circle-x, clock, columns-3, copy, credit-card, dollar-sign, download, ellipsis, ellipsis-vertical, external-link, eye, eye-off, file-text, flag, folder, funnel, globe, grip-vertical, hash, heart, house, image, inbox, info, key, layout-dashboard, link, list, list-todo, loader, loader-circle, lock, log-in, log-out, mail, map-pin, menu, message-square, minus, monitor, moon, octagon-x, panel-left, paperclip, pause, pencil, phone, pin, play, plus, printer, refresh-cw, rotate-ccw, rotate-ccw-clock, save, search, send, settings, share-2, shield, shopping-bag, shopping-cart, sliders-horizontal, smartphone, sparkles, square-pen, star, sun, tag, thumbs-down, thumbs-up, trash, trending-down, trending-up, triangle-alert, upload, user, user-plus, users, x, zap. Lucide aliases (`trash-2`, `home`, `more-horizontal`, ...) and PascalCase (`Trash2Icon`) are accepted; `hero-*` names pass through to Phoenix Heroicons; other names raise `ArgumentError`.

## Aliases

Common names → family (`function/1`).

- toast, notification, snackbar, flash popup → `sonner` (`toaster/1`): mount `<.toaster id="toaster" />` once, then `push_event(socket, "shadcn:toast", %{toaster: "toaster", message: ...})` from the LiveView
- modal, popup window, lightbox → `dialog` (`dialog/1`): server-controlled `open`; handle `shadcn:modal-open`/`shadcn:modal-close`
- confirm, are-you-sure, destructive confirmation → `alert_dialog` (`alert_dialog/1`): same `open`/modal events contract as `dialog`, with action/cancel buttons
- select, dropdown (form field) → `native_select` (`native_select/1`), `select` (`select/1`): `native_select` = real `<select>` bound with `field={@form[:x]}`; `select` = styled listbox with hook + `on_change`
- autocomplete, typeahead, searchable select → `combobox` (`combobox/1`): filterable input + listbox
- command palette, spotlight, cmd+k → `command` (`command/1`): put it inside `dialog` for a modal palette
- menu, actions menu, kebab/overflow menu → `dropdown_menu` (`dropdown_menu/1`), `context_menu` (`context_menu/1`), `menubar` (`menubar/1`): `dropdown_menu` from a trigger; `context_menu` on right-click; `menubar` for app menus
- drawer, bottom sheet → `drawer` (`drawer/1`): slides from an edge (bottom by default)
- side panel, off-canvas, slide-over → `sheet` (`sheet/1`): dialog anchored to a side
- datatable, data grid, sortable table → `data_table` (`data_table/1`), `table` (`table/1`): `data_table` = server-side sorting, search, pagination, selection, column visibility and row menus (state in `ShadcnLiveview.DataTable.State`, see usage-rules/data-tables.md); `table` = markup only
- link button, button link → `button` (`button/1`): `navigate=` / `patch=` / `href=` render `Phoenix.Component.link/1` with button styling
- icons, lucide, heroicons → `icon` (`icon/1`): Lucide subset listed under Icons below; unknown names raise
- form, labeled input, form group, validation errors → `form` (`form_field/1`), `field` (`field/1`): `form_field` wraps input/textarea/native_select/checkbox/switch/radio_group with label, description, errors; pass `label="..."` or a `<:label_content>` slot for rich label markup (exactly one); `field_*` for manual layouts
- toggle switch, on/off → `switch` (`switch/1`), `checkbox` (`checkbox/1`), `toggle` (`toggle/1`): `toggle` is a pressed button, not a form checkbox
- segmented control, button toggle set → `toggle_group` (`toggle_group/1`), `tabs` (`tabs/1`): `tabs` when it switches panels
- expandable, disclosure, FAQ → `accordion` (`accordion/1`), `collapsible` (`collapsible/1`)
- date picker → `calendar` (`calendar/1`), `popover` (`popover/1`): calendar inside a popover
- loading, loader → `spinner` (`spinner/1`), `skeleton` (`skeleton/1`), `progress` (`progress/1`)
- chip, tag, pill, status label → `badge` (`badge/1`)
- tooltip, hint, hover info → `tooltip` (`tooltip/1`), `hover_card` (`hover_card/1`)
- navbar, top navigation, mega menu → `navigation_menu` (`navigation_menu/1`), `sidebar` (`sidebar/1`), `breadcrumb` (`breadcrumb/1`)
- pin code, OTP, verification code → `input_otp` (`input_otp/1`)
- chat, conversation → `message` (`message/1`), `bubble` (`bubble/1`), `message_scroller` (`message_scroller/1`)
- range, volume slider → `slider` (`slider/1`)
- divider, hr → `separator` (`separator/1`)
- keyboard shortcut, hotkey → `kbd` (`kbd/1`)
- empty state, zero state, no results → `empty` (`empty/1`)
- callout, banner, inline alert → `alert` (`alert/1`)
